description:
Witch Transformation: When you activate your Guardian Transformation, or as an action while in Guardian form, you may choose to gain 1 strain and transform into a Witch form. When you do, increment your power die. While in this form your spellcasting techniques gain additional damage equal to your Strain. Gain +1 strain at the beginning of each of your turns. If you become overstrained while in this form, roll on the “Curse Table” below. The curse lasts until the end of combat. Once you activate this form, it cannot be activated again until you take a short rest.

Curse Table - Roll a D6

Result / Effect
1 / Your maximum HP drops to 1
2 / You cannot cast spells
3 / You are off-guard 2
4 / You are immobilized
5 / You are Stunned 1
6 / You cannot gain energy
name: Dark Witch Path Initiate

description: The power inside of you is more than you can control, so most of the time it stays locked down. However, in moments of intense danger the power can come bursting out. As an action you can choose to gain 1 strain and transform into your Soulrager form. When you activate your Soulrager Transformation, increment your Power Die by 1. You gain armor equal to your Martial Arts rank, and your unarmed strikes also deal increased damage equal to this amount. At the end of each of your turns, you gain 1 strain while in this form. Whenever you exit this form, or become overstrained while in this form, you take damage equal to your current strain. Once you activate this form, it cannot be activated again until you take a short rest.

Tactical Order: You gain a number of “Commands” equal to your Heart attribute. When an ally you can see makes an attack roll, you may choose to spend one “Command” to add +1D to that ally’s roll (after seeing the result of their roll, but before determining the outcome). description:
Shared Emblem: When you choose this path, you can choose a number of allies to include in your "Squad". Each of these allies gets a small trinket - a badge, coin, crystal, etc. When you perform your Heroic Transformation, you can share some of your power with those allies. They each get a benefit, based on your current Emblem:
Wild Animal: Your squad also gains the damage bonus against enemies you mark with "Mark Prey".
Prehistoric Beast: Your squad is also treated as +1 scale for the purposes of forced movement.
Mythical Creature: Each member of the squad can perform Mythic Rebirth once per short rest.
Insect: Your squad also gains 5 armor against bleeding and poison
Element: Each member of the squad chooses an element. They learn Rank 1 "Elemental Kinesis" with that element.
Vehicle: Each member of the squad also gains a rank 1 vehicle, and can summon it as an action.
Ancient Warriors: All allies benefit from any circumstance bonuses granted by "Know Your Enemy".

description:
Emblem Mech: You gain a Rank 1 mech. It takes a form that represents your current Emblem. It gains one trait based on your Emblem:
Wild Animal: Climber, Burrower, Amphibious, or Wings
Prehistoric Beast: Giant Frame
Mythical Creature: Energy Barrier
Insect: Hexapede Chassis
Element: Elemental Blaster
Vehicle: Vehicle Conversion
Ancient Warriors: Giant Weapon
While piloting your Emblem Mech, your aura extends from the mech's location.

description:
Giant of Light Form: When performing your Heroic Transformation, or as an action while in hero form, you may choose to gain 1 strain and transform into a Giant of Light form. When you do, increment your power die. Your scale increases by 1, and you gain +1 armor (stacking with your Hero form’s armor). While in this form you gain +1 strain at the beginning of each of your turns. Once you activate this form, it cannot be activated again until you take a short rest.
Psionic Abilities: You gain 1 psionic skill technique when you choose this feat, and have access to the psionic list when learning new techniques. You may perform these techniques using your Henshin Arts skill. You may only use these techniques while in your Giant of Light form.
name: Giant of Light Initiate

description:
Armor Modes: You are adept at adapting your armor to the circumstances. You gain access to two of the following modes. You choose one mode when you activate your Heroic Transformation, and can switch modes as an action.
Speed Mode: Gain additional movement speed equal to your Henshin Arts Rank.
Sniper Mode: All ranged attacks you make gain additional range equal to twice your Henshin Arts Rank.
Shield Mode: Gain additional armor equal to your Henshin Arts rank. Reduce your movement speed by 2.
Sensor Mode: Gain "Spirit Sight". The range is 3 times your Henshin Arts Rank.
Jump Mode: You gain the "Enhanced Leaps" trait
Stealth Mode: You gain the "Natural Camouflage" trait
Power Mode: Increase your Strength by 1. Your scale is treated as 1 higher for grappling creatures and moving objects.
Amphibious Mode: You gain the "Amphibious" trait
name: Masked Rider Initiate
notes: Intended feat listed under Henshin Hero Feats Level 2 in the handbook.

description: Monstrous Mimicry: You may make an "Analyze Enemy" action against an enemy you can see to learn their traits. On a success, you are able to replace one trait from your Monstrous Form with one of that enemy's traits, until the end of combat. While transformed in this way, you may perform a technique that uses that trait, if you've seen the enemy use that technique.
name: Mimic Path Initiate

description: Shape Stealer: Your metamorphic powers not only allow you to transform yourself into a unique form, but also to mimic shapes you've seen. You learn the "Doppelganger" technique, and can also use it to take the form of a scale 1 object you have seen. For each metamorphosis rank above 1, you may add or subtract 1 from the scale of the object or creature you take the form of.
name: Shape Stealer

sourceValues.description: Shape Stealer: Your metamorphic powers not only allow you to transform yourself into a unique form, but also to mimic shapes you've seen. You learn the "Doppelganger" technique, and can also use it to take the form of a scale 1 object you have seen. For each metamorphosis rank above 1, you may add or subtract 1 from the scale of the object or creature you take the form of.
sourceValues.name: Shape Stealer

description: Creature Catalogue: You can permanently learn a number of monster traits you have discovered. The total number of traits you can remember at a time is equal to twice your Metamorphosis skill rank. When you transform, you may choose to replace one of your normal Metamorphic Transformation traits with one of your "Catalogue" traits. If you learn a trait using Monstrous Mimicry, if you already know your maximum number of traits you may choose to forget a trait and replace it with your newly learned trait. When you learn a new trait, you may also learn 1 technique associated with that trait. When you activate that trait, you may perform the associated technique.
